title: Renaissance Handmade Men's Travel Necktie, Europe/USA - NWOT
descriptionText: Elevate your style with this RENAISSANCE hand-made men's neck tie, featuring a multi-color design inspired by travel destinations throughout Europe and USA. Crafted from high-quality polyester material, this tie measures 58 inches in length and 3-1/2 inches in width, making it the perfect addition to any fashionable gentleman's wardrobe. Ideal for any occasion, whether dressing up for a formal event or adding a pop of color to your everyday work attire, this neck tie is sure to make a statement.
